name: pull all ticks
summary: This EA is a tick data download utility that systematically pulls historical tick data from the broker for all symbols in the Market Watch. It uses a download manager with persistent state to resume downloads across terminal restarts, navigating through symbols automatically via chart symbol/period switching.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个逐笔数据下载工具，系统性地从经纪商拉取市场观察中所有品种的历史Tick数据。它使用带有持久化状态的下载管理器，支持终端重启后恢复下载，并通过自动切换图表品种/周期来遍历所有品种。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不执行任何交易策略，而是一个纯工具型EA，用于批量下载历史Tick数据。其核心逻辑分为两个阶段：首先通过从当前时间向历史方向以30天为步长跳跃式查询CopyTicks，找到经纪商可提供的最老Tick时间戳；然后从该最老时间戳开始，以用户指定的包大小逐批拉取所有Tick数据直到最新的K线时间。下载管理器（CDownloadManager）负责遍历市场观察中的所有品种，通过将状态保存到二进制文件实现断点续传，每次处理完一个品种后通过ChartSetSymbolPeriod切换到下一个品种继续下载。入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理和资金管理均不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not execute any trading strategy; it is a pure utility designed for batch downloading historical tick data. Its core logic operates in two phases: first, it discovers the oldest available tick timestamp from the broker by querying CopyTicks in reverse-chronological jumps of 30 days from the current server time; second, it sequentially pulls all ticks from that oldest timestamp to the most recent candle time in user-specified batch sizes. The CDownloadManager struct orchestrates traversal of all Market Watch symbols, persisting its state (symbol list, current index, started/finished flags) to a binary file for crash recovery and resume capability. After completing tick downloads for one symbol, it uses ChartSetSymbolPeriod to navigate the chart to the next symbol and continue the process. Entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, and money management are all inapplicable since the EA performs zero trading operations.

parameters.name: limitDate
parameters.description: 是否启用日期限制，控制是否在到达最老时间限制时停止搜索
parameters.description_en: Enable date limit; stops search at oldest limit

parameters.name: oldestLimit
parameters.description: 最老日期限制，当启用日期限制时，搜索到此日期即停止
parameters.description_en: Oldest date limit for search termination

parameters.name: tick_packets
parameters.description: 每次CopyTicks请求的Tick包大小，每个Tick约60字节，需根据内存调整
parameters.description_en: Tick packet size per CopyTicks request (~60 bytes/tick)

pros: 具有断点续传功能，通过二进制文件保存下载状态，终端重启后可恢复
自动遍历市场观察中所有品种，无需手动逐个操作
采用二分跳跃式搜索最老Tick，比线性搜索更高效
支持日期限制参数，避免下载过久远的数据
使用定时器驱动而非OnTick，确保在无行情时也能运行
pros_en: Crash recovery via persistent binary state file, enabling resume after terminal restart
Automatic traversal of all Market Watch symbols without manual intervention
Efficient oldest-tick discovery using 30-day jump increments instead of linear scanning
Configurable date limit to prevent downloading excessively old data
Timer-driven execution ensures operation even without incoming ticks
cons: 缺少错误处理，CopyTicks返回-1时仅增加尝试次数但不记录或报告具体错误
Sleep(44)硬编码可能导致某些经纪商触发请求频率限制
通过ChartSetSymbolPeriod切换品种的方式不够优雅，会触发图表重绘和指标重载
当oldest==LONG_MAX（未找到任何Tick）时仅弹出提示，没有重试机制
没有进度百分比或日志输出，用户难以判断整体下载进度
cons_en: Lacks proper error handling - CopyTicks returning -1 only increments attempts without logging the specific error
Hard-coded Sleep(44) may trigger broker request frequency limits or be insufficient for some servers
Chart symbol/period switching is a brute-force navigation method that triggers chart redraws and indicator reloads
No retry mechanism when no ticks are found (oldest==LONG_MAX), only an Alert and ExpertRemove
No progress percentage or detailed logging, making it hard for users to gauge overall download progress
improvements: 添加更完善的错误处理和重试机制，包括CopyTicks失败的具体错误码记录和指数退避策略
使用更精确的进度报告机制，如进度百分比、预计剩余时间和详细日志输出
improvements_en: Add comprehensive error handling with retry mechanisms including CopyTicks error code logging and exponential backoff for server throttling
Implement detailed progress reporting with percentage completion, estimated time remaining, and per-symbol download statistics logging

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，无资金风险
大量CopyTicks请求可能触发经纪商的API频率限制或被标记为异常行为
risk_points_en: No trading operations are performed, posing zero financial risk
High-volume CopyTicks requests may trigger broker API rate limits or be flagged as abnormal activity
